GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly missing start 1 length and Settled Down last of six runners and 5.5 Lengths from the lead, railed up to 2.5 Lengths turning, Held Up home turn until the 300m, didn't really pick up with clear running, did run up onto heels inside the 100m but was still unconvincing to the line # Had minor excuses

Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 4 Lengths on fence, made no ground to turn, railed up rounding turn, came through and kept chasing in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly middle stages. # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Raced keenly in the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out Straight Out The Back Settled Down last 9 Lengths remained well back to Straightening Up clear run home ran on to the line Sound - # outpaced ran on

Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 7 Lengths on fence, railed to 6 Lengths turning, Held Up home turn and blocked in straight, switched inside passing 200m, kept coming and Made Some Ground to the line # no luck in Straight
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up for clear running approaching the 400m until approaching the 200m. Near the 25m shifted in and bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , enjoyed rails trail behind speed 2 Lengths 600m, just needed a run before the corner, gap opened off fence when balanced-up and drove Through to challenge, took over 200m and dashed away to win with something in hand # dominant last 200m
Jumped Ok , got back last 7 Lengths 700m, ridden for luck staying back inside Straightening Up , gap opened last 200m and he drove Through final stages for big win from the back # weaving win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Tightened between runners shortly after the start and lost ground. Steadied from heels approaching the home turn.

Jumped okay, Restrained & Settled Down 8 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back (5 Lengths leader) to 12 Lengths turning, hooked Wide Straightening Up and Made Good Ground in Straight # got too far back
Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths Two Wide , out 3 Wide middle stages, trailed 3 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight # mostly Wide

A bit slow out & Settled Down 4 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 5.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, hooked wider Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in straight. (Tongue Tie AGAIN, Winkers OFF AGAIN) # no real excuses
Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths 3 Wide With Cover , Drifted Back to 4 Lengths 3 Wide With Cover turning, carried wider 300m then improved only marginally in Straight # wide, had cover
Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.5 Lengths Five Wide , back to 2.5 Lengths Four Wide turning, Dropped Out in Straight # never on track
